nodes.label: How Good Are Frontier Models at Physics? Expert Re-Grading Reveals Broken Evaluations
nodes.author: Ali Ansari, Haoran Sun, Andy Zeyi Liu, Mark Jabbour, et al.

nodes.label: Expert Physics Benchmark Audit
nodes.rationale: Systematic expert review of physics benchmarks to distinguish genuine model errors from grader errors and benchmark defects.

nodes.label: Benchmark Error Classification
nodes.rationale: Errors in problem statements or reference solutions, including incorrect answers, inconsistent conditions, ambiguity, or missing assumptions.

nodes.label: Grader Error Classification
nodes.rationale: Correct model answers rejected by evaluators, primarily due to rule-based evaluators failing to recognize equivalent mathematical forms.

nodes.label: Model Error Classification
nodes.rationale: Genuine model errors where problem is well-posed, reference solution is correct, but model gives incorrect answer.

nodes.label: HLE-Physics Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Expert-authored physics subset of Humanity's Last Exam with 202 text-only questions; pre-audit mean@4 47.3% rises to 78.7% after correction.

nodes.label: CMT-Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Expert-authored condensed matter theory benchmark with 50 questions; pre-audit mean@4 61.0% rises to 87.2% after expert repair.

nodes.label: CritPt Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Expert-curated frontier physics challenges; pre-audit mean@5 32.3% rises to mean@4 87.5% on 54 retained challenges after expert correction.

nodes.label: PHYBench Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Public-source physics benchmark with 100 problems from high-school to Physics Olympiad difficulty; grader errors dominate audit set.

nodes.label: PRISM-Physics Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Public-source benchmark with 1,401 text-only physics questions; 64.86% of audited rejections are grader errors.

nodes.label: UGPhysics Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Undergraduate physics benchmark with 5,520 English text-only questions; 81.82% of audited rejections are benchmark errors.

nodes.label: Benchmark Saturation and Defect Masking
nodes.rationale: As model capability grows, true error rate drops below benchmark defect rate; defects become dominant source of reported errors, masking true performance.

nodes.label: Rule-Based Evaluator Brittleness
nodes.rationale: Rule-based evaluators (exact-match, symbolic) reject equivalent answers in different forms; PHYBench and PRISM-Physics show 71.43% and 64.86% grader error rates.
